thread:
alex_k: Quick sync — pushed a WIP PR for the new Errors-by-Route dashboard widgets to feature/obs-errors. It exposes 3 panels: p95 latency, error rate, and top error messages. PR: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/482

maya_ops: Nice. Do we have owners locked for the retention bump on trace logs? Last planning said 90d but I don't see the owner in the RFC. Also need to know if hosted console can query the trace-logs store (it's on a dedicated cluster). :thinking_face:

sam_r: I'm the owner for the dashboard panels (will shepherd the PR). The retention change is separate — I thought infra would take that? @leo_infra can you confirm read role availability for console?

leo_infra: I can take ownership of the trace retention rollout. Current plan: increase trace-logs retention to 90d in staging on Mon, smoke test for a week, then promote. Need console to use the read-only role `trace-console-reader` (I can create it). Also note: cluster-level read requires a VPC peering rule from the hosting VPC.

alex_k: Thx. Two quick blockers then: 1) permissions (leo) 2) we need a tracing hook to propagate request_id into span and logs for the new panels to correlate errors. Sam — do you have that in a PR?

sam_r: Yup, opened PR 483 for the tracing hook and propagation: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/483. Minimal change, adds header passthrough and span tag \`request_id\`. Code:```yaml
# example header passthrough config
tracing:
  passthrough_headers:
    - X-Request-Id
```

jen_p: I'll take the canary smoke for the dashboard once PRs are merged. Assign me when ready. Also, small UX ask: can we add a small top-line that links back to the failing traces in the error panel? Makes triage faster.

sam_r: Good call, jen. I'll add a link column that builds a trace-ui URL using `trace_id`. Will include in the PR update.

leo_infra: I've created `trace-console-reader` in staging and added IAM policy to allow read only to the trace-logs bucket. Need to run a quick test from staging console; alex, can you run the dashboard queries against staging?

alex_k: I'll run them after lunch. FYI the query pattern uses: `SELECT count(*) FROM traces WHERE route = :route AND status >= 500 GROUP BY bin(5m)` — might need an index on `route` in the trace store for perf.

maya_ops: ACTIONS:
- leo_infra: finish peering + role in staging (owner)
- sam_r: finish tracing hook PR + add trace link column (owner)
- alex_k: run dashboard queries against staging + flag perf issues (owner)
- jen_p: canary smoke + UX feedback (owner)

deploy-bot: canary deployed: console-obs v1.17.0-canary -> us-west-2 :rocket:

alex_k: Great, if canary looks green let's merge the dashboard PR and schedule retention rollout. I'll post results in this thread. :thumbsup:
